newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded but quoted higher on API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded but quoted higher on API.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were untraded around midday but indicated firmer in line with a stronger NYMEX complex following U.S. stock data.
Brent for January was quoted on SIMEX at $22.80/$22.88 per barrel, after London firmed 12 cents to settle at $22.74.
But brokers said the NYMEX complex was higher in the wake of American Petroleum Institute (API) data on Tuesday.
The data showed a fall in crude stocks of 2.03 million barrels after refinery operating rates hit 93.7 percent from a week earlier at 92.9 percent.

Heating oil was also boosted by data showing heating oil stocks fell by just more than one million barrels in the East Coast. However, overall distillate stocks were 660,000 barrels higher with distillate output at near record levels of 3.61 million barrels per day (bpd).
NYMEX January crude futures, which rose 13 cents in New York to $23.62 per barrel, extended gains on ACCESS to last trade in Asia at $23.72.
December heating oil, which dropped 0.99 cents in New York, clawed back 0.61 cent of the losses on ACCESS.
